name: data-database-async-dml-runtime

source.content: Account inserted = new Account(Name = 'Async Insert'); Object insertAsync = Database.insertAsync(inserted); Database.SaveResult insertResult = Database.getAsyncSaveResult(insertAsync); System.assert(insertResult.isSuccess()); System.assertEquals(inserted.Id, insertResult.getId()); Account insertedWithAccess = new Account(Name = 'Async Insert Access'); Object insertAccessAsync = Database.insertAsync(insertedWithAccess, AccessLevel.USER_MODE); Database.SaveResult insertAccessResult = Database.getAsyncSaveResult(insertAccessAsync); System.assert(insertAccessResult.isSuccess()); System.assertEquals(insertedWithAccess.Id, insertAccessResult.getId()); inserted.Name = 'Async Update'; Object updateAsync = Database.updateAsync(inserted); Database.SaveResult updateResult = Database.getAsyncSaveResult(updateAsync); System.assert(updateResult.isSuccess()); Account updatedWithAccess = new Account(Id = insertedWithAccess.Id, Name = 'Async Update Access'); Object updateAccessAsync = Database.updateAsync(updatedWithAccess, AccessLevel.USER_MODE); Database.SaveResult updateAccessResult = Database.getAsyncSaveResult(updateAccessAsync); System.assert(updateAccessResult.isSuccess()); Account deleted = new Account(Name = 'Async Delete'); insert deleted; Object deleteAsync = Database.deleteAsync(deleted); Database.DeleteResult deleteResult = Database.getAsyncDeleteResult(deleteAsync); System.assert(deleteResult.isSuccess()); Account deletedWithAccess = new Account(Name = 'Async Delete Access'); insert deletedWithAccess; Object deleteAccessAsync = Database.deleteAsync(deletedWithAccess, AccessLevel.USER_MODE); Database.DeleteResult deleteAccessResult = Database.getAsyncDeleteResult(deleteAccessAsync); System.assert(deleteAccessResult.isSuccess()); List<Account> rows = Database.query('SELECT Id, Name, IsDeleted FROM Account WHERE Id IN :new Set<Id>{inserted.Id, insertedWithAccess.Id, deleted.Id, deletedWithAccess.Id} ALL ROWS'); System.assertEquals(4, rows.size()); for (Account row : rows) { if (row.Id == inserted.Id) System.assertEquals('Async Update', row.Name); if (row.Id == insertedWithAccess.Id) System.assertEquals('Async Update Access', row.Name); if (row.Id == deleted.Id || row.Id == deletedWithAccess.Id) System.assert(row.IsDeleted); }
